scope: Real RadixCache CPU semantic value-term ablation; symbolic allocator; no GPU inference, service latency or starvation guarantee

provenance.scope: Real RadixCache CPU semantic value-term ablation; symbolic allocator; no GPU inference, service latency or starvation guarantee

formula_semantics.full: Existing probability times external age decay times depth cost proxy, capped bonus plus recency
formula_semantics.no_depth: Remove only the external depth cost multiplier; keep the learner's depth feature
formula_semantics.no_decay: Remove only the external age decay; keep learned reuse-interval/frequency features
formula_semantics.no_bonus: Use recency score; retain indexed candidates and all observation/training work

provenance.clock: request ordinal times fixed interval; reset to zero per arm
provenance.reset: Fresh cache and zero learner weights per arm; no transfer between seeds; no selection on held-out seeds
provenance.tie_note: Production heap order unchanged; repeat digest excludes CPU timings and exact-score tied victim identity

comparison: Each removed value term is compared with full, using the same trained learner; this is not a frozen-learner or independent LRU comparison.
statistics_note: Win/tie/loss uses total reused tokens within paired workloads. Pooled delta is a ratio of sums, not a mean percentage or serving improvement.
